about: THE ONION ALLOWLIST. The ONLY .onion addresses research/onion_mirrors.py may request. Each entry is a lawful public mirror that its own publisher announces on its own clearnet page (announced_at). Scope (principal 2026-10-13): lawful public onion sites and ugly public data are IN; darknet markets, hub/carding forums, ransomware leak sites, stolen data and MNPI are OUT, always -- the validator refuses any entry whose category is not in allowed_categories or whose text names an out-of-scope kind. No crawling beyond these URLs, no link following. Fetching stays OFF until the auditor rules on Tor egress (reports/audit/2026-10-29/ONION_LANE.md). Every onion host is IDEAS_ONLY in libs/data/terms_fence.SOURCE_POLICY['onion_mirrors']: never live input.
